preconditions.description: The number of lines of the conversation is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The permutation string M is exactly 26 characters long.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in M)
preconditions.description: The permutation string M is a permutation of the English alphabet.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_?!.,' for line in input_lines for c in line)
preconditions.description: Each sentence contains only lowercase letters, uppercase letters, underscores, and punctuation symbols.
Each sentence is at most 100 characters long.

postconditions.description: Each translated sentence is at most 100 characters long.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line.replace('_', ' ') == translate_bytelandian_to_english(input_line, M) for input_line, output_line in zip(input_lines, outputs))
postconditions.description: Each translated sentence is the English translation of the corresponding Bytelandian sentence using the given permutation M.
Each translated sentence contains only printable characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz ' for line in outputs for c in line)
postconditions.description: Each translated sentence contains only lowercase letters and spaces.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for line in outputs for c in line if c.isupper())
postconditions.description: Each translated sentence containing an uppercase letter retains its case.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '?!.,' for line in outputs for c in line if c in '?!.,')
postconditions.description: Each punctuation symbol in the Bytelandian sentence remains the same in the English translation.
